test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

William ______ his friends not to intrude into his family’s affairs.
solution:
The correct answer is '**warned'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**warned**'.
 
• It means **'to tell somebody about something unpleasant or dangerous that exists or might happen, so that he/she can avoid it'.** [(किसी व्‍यक्ति को) आसन्‍न, विद्यमान प्रतिकूलता या ख़तरे की पूर्वसूचना देना, (से) सचेत करना (ताकि वह अपना बचाव कर सके)]
 
 
• *Example: When I saw the car coming I tried to **warn** him, but it was too late.*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **claimed**: to say that something is true, without having any proof. (बिना प्रमाण प्रस्‍तुत किए सत्‍यता का दावा करना)
 
• **gambled**: to bet money on the result of a card game, horse race, etc. (ताश का खेल, घुड़दौड़ आदि के परिणामों पर बाज़ी लगाना; जुआ खेलना)
 
• **satisfied**: pleased because you have had or done what you wanted. (अभीष्‍ट काम को संपन्‍न करने या वस्‍तु को प्राप्‍त करने पर प्रसन्‍न; संतुष्‍ट)
 
 
 
• Thus, as per the above definitions, we find that the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *William **warned** his friends not to intrude into his family's affairs.*
